summary: Each source-derived edit retains another full source document and opens another non-preview native tab; neither Close nor disposal prunes the documents cache, so one source editing session grows without the study/decision limits.
fix: Keep a replaceable source-derived reader separate from immutable observed-source URIs, coalesce baseline change events, and bound/cache only currently needed or open captured documents; release obsolete cached entries when their owned tabs close and when the reader is disposed.
evidence: The watcher and document-change handlers call readBaselines().then(() => renderSelection()) (lines 402-408). Each changed source hash enters the URI and documents.set(uri.toString(), source.text) (323-324), then showTextDocument uses preview:false (329). No documents.delete/clear exists, including close/dispose (205-218). A causal harness using the current transpiled StudyWorkspace methods with native APIs stubbed performed 100 distinct approximately 8 KiB source-derived revisions: 100 non-preview source opens, 100 cached documents, 821290 retained text bytes, and 100 cached documents still after close. This is method-level retention evidence, not native-tab or timing QA.

summary: Archive write latency blocks live pause selection and source/context refresh: refresh awaits checkpoint before following the current pause or rendering, and checkpoint awaits saveStudy plus listing even after its archive is already captured.
fix: Separate the bounded/coalesced archive writer from live projection refresh. Publish/follow committed in-memory evidence without waiting for disk writes, report save status separately, and await the writer only at explicit final-checkpoint/retirement boundaries. Add a deferred-save regression proving a later pause and control status still render before storage is released.
evidence: refresh executes await this.checkpoint(this.service, record) before selection.follow and renderSelection (258-264); checkpoint assigns activeArchive at 276 but waits for library.saveStudy/archive listing at 277. Concurrent refresh calls return the same pending promise (255). The control finally block also awaits refresh before its final publish (160). A causal harness using the current methods with saveStudy held pending observed archiveAlreadyCaptured:true, renderCount:0, selectedStudy:null; releasing that save produced renderCount:1 and selectedStudy:instance_record. Native effects/capture provider were stubbed. This establishes UI update dependency on storage, not an observed real-disk latency or blocked MCP protocol call.
